label: prf:markov-trace-factorization
title: Proof of markov trace factorization
html:
Proof of factorization

The nuclear braid word is a product of crossing factors, each acting at a single generator \sigma_i. After Hecke reduction (the only energy-changing step, Gröbner--Shirshov energy), the crossings at generator \sigma_i reduce to a_i \sigma_i + b_i.

The full reduced element is the product \prod_{i=0}^{A-2} (a_i \sigma_i + b_i) where the factors are ordered by generator index (right to left: \sigma_{A-2} first, \sigma_0 last).

The Markov trace processes this product by peeling generators from the right. At each step, \sigma_i is the rightmost (largest) generator in the remaining word, and the Markov property gives:

  \mathrm{tr}(\cdots (a_i \sigma_i + b_i))
  = 
  (z \cdot a_i + b_i) \cdot \mathrm{tr}(\cdots).

This works because:

  1. The chain at \sigma_i reduces to a_i \sigma_i + b_i (a linear combination of \sigma_i and the identity).

  2. The Markov property \mathrm{tr}(x \sigma_n) = z\mathrm{tr}(x) applies to the \sigma_i term, and \mathrm{tr}(x \cdot 1) = \mathrm{tr}(x) for the identity term.

  3. Generator \sigma_i is the rightmost active generator when processing from right to left, so the Markov property applies directly.

  4. The remaining word after peeling \sigma_i involves only generators \sigma_0, \ldots, \sigma_{i-1}, which are independent of \sigma_i.

Applying this recursively from i = A-2 down to i = 0 gives the product formula. \square

The ratio = 1.000000 in the computational verification is exact by construction — the product formula and the direct trace compute the same algebraic object. The canonical verification confirms code correctness, not an approximation. The values below were computed under the excised convention-C weight z = \sqrt q/(q+1) by a producer now in computations/_deprecated/; they are not the canonical traces (for {}^{2}\mathrm{H} the convention-D value is z = q^3/(q^2+1) \approx 0.61269). The ratio column does not depend on the convention, because the factorization is an algebraic identity in z.

Nucleus A \binom{A}{2} \prod_i \hat{V}_i Direct trace Ratio
{}^{2}\mathrm{H} 2 1 0.49932008 0.49932008 1

For heavy nuclei (A > 6), only the product formula is tractable — the direct computation exceeds 10^5 terms.
